# mapbox_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Reads the value of an existing Mapbox token without storing it in plan or state. Pair it with a `mapbox_token` resource that sets `store_token = false`. Only public tokens are supported: Mapbox returns the value of secret tokens once, at creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keep a public token's value out of state and read it only when needed.
resource "mapbox_token" "example" {
  username    = "example"
  note        = "example"
  scopes      = ["styles:read", "fonts:read"]
  store_token = false
}

ephemeral "mapbox_token" "example" {
  username = mapbox_token.example.username
  # The resource id has the form "<token_id>:<username>".
  token_id = split(":", mapbox_token.example.id)[0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `token_id` (String) Token identifier.
- `username` (String) The username of the account that owns the token.

### Read-Only

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token value.
